headline: 今日无新片，侠探杰克领跑热搜
headlineEn: No new releases today; Jack Reacher leads hot searches
summary: 今日（8月13日）无新片上映，本周共6部新片。热搜由《侠探杰克》领跑，《小黄人与大怪兽》《奥德赛》紧随其后。
summaryEn: No new films were released today (Aug 13), with 6 new titles this week. Jack Reacher leads trending, followed by Minions and the Big Monster and The Odyssey.
